sentence: This project provides tissue processing equipment that helps vision researchers prepare, stain and image tissue samples.
This project tries to find out which genetic variants that raise coronary artery disease risk change how target genes are expressed.
This project studies how resistance to antimalarial drugs in Plasmodium falciparum parasites is emerging across Uganda and which genotypes contribute to it.
This project uses multi-omics technologies to find genetic determinants and metabolites linked to atherosclerosis.
This project studies what affects substance use and HIV outcomes among people who use drugs like stimulants and opioids.
This project tries to find out how pentameric ligand-gated ion channels work and are controlled at a molecular level.
This project studies why some acute myeloid leukemia with mutated isocitrate dehydrogenase resists differentiation therapy, using mouse models and patient samples.
This project tries to find out which signals and molecular regulators control homing receptors on human T cells.
This project uses in vivo models to study the early molecular drivers of a small round blue cell sarcoma and its immune evasion.
This project uses artificial intelligence to draw smaller geographic zones inside counties so cancer registry data can be reported more clearly in Texas.
This project applies artificial intelligence and data science methods to analyze complex datasets for HIV prevention, treatment and cure research.
This project studies how a fusion oncoprotein and a transcription factor lead to resistance to therapy in childhood acute myeloid leukemia.
This project tries to find out how dendritic cells drive immune responses to immunotherapies in patients with bladder cancer.
This project studies whether social threat and physical pain in the moment predict suicidal ideation, and how the brain responds, in adolescence.
This project builds an in vitro model using human and murine cells to test gene therapies for Duchenne muscular dystrophy.
This project studies how cell adhesion molecule-1 and focal adhesion kinase help mast cells and sensory neurons interact during anaphylaxis caused by an allergen.
This project makes compounds that direct a macrophage to break down protein kinase G, an enzyme of Mycobacterium tuberculosis.
This project studies how methylation of histone 3 lysine 79 controls chromatin and neuronal development.
This project builds machine learning tools that identify bacteria and their specialized metabolites from mass spectrometry data.
